metrics.arm: phasebind2_rjpred_yaw = phasebind2_rjpred + the objects' yaw read where it varies across the task's rendered placements (std > 3 deg)

hypotheses.Y1: phasebind2_rjpred_yaw > phasebind2_rjpred: exact two-sided sign test p < 0.05

metrics.tasks: the 11 book tasks of the stream pool (73, 74, 75, 78, 80, 81, 83, 86, 87, 88, 89); init states 30-49; 220 paired episodes
metrics.why: books lie at a random yaw (about 13 deg across placements); the readers assumed a fixed yaw (the demo's or the rendered mean), 10.2 deg off at the median; experiments/p6_yaw_reader.py reads it at 0.8 deg (ledger p6_reader tag yaw)
